title: Enhance SEC Filing Fetch Monitoring System
description: Improve the SEC filing fetch monitoring system to better handle XBRL parsing challenges, enhance monitoring capabilities, and optimize logging for debugging complex financial data
details:
This task involves comprehensive improvements to the SEC filing fetch monitoring system across three key areas:

1. XBRL Parsing Improvements:
   - Implement namespace handling enhancements
   - Develop context reference processing
   - Add decimal precision handling
   - Optimize for large documents
   - Support company-specific extensions
   - Extract HTML content effectively

2. Monitoring System Enhancements:
   - Add taxonomy-specific monitoring
   - Implement size-based metrics
   - Create context reference validation
   - Track namespace resolution
   - Monitor embedded HTML content
   - Check attribute completeness
   - Perform segment-based analysis

3. Enhanced Logging Optimizations:
   - Implement structured XML logging
   - Add visual indicators for parsing stages
   - Create smart truncation for large elements
   - Visualize context mapping
   - Correlate URL attempts with parsing errors
   - Recognize error patterns
   - Track performance metrics

The implementation will follow a phased approach, starting with logging optimizations for immediate visibility, followed by parsing improvements to address core functionality, and finally monitoring system enhancements to track and analyze improvements.
testStrategy:
Testing for this implementation will follow a comprehensive approach:

1. Unit Testing:
   - Test each parsing utility function individually
   - Validate namespace resolution with various inputs
   - Test context reference processing with edge cases
   - Verify decimal precision handling accuracy

2. Integration Testing:
   - Test the complete parsing pipeline with real SEC filings
   - Verify monitoring data collection and storage
   - Test API endpoints for monitoring data retrieval
   - Validate logging output format and content

3. Performance Testing:
   - Measure parsing performance with various file sizes
   - Test memory usage during large document processing
   - Verify streaming parser efficiency
   - Benchmark XML traversal optimizations

4. Validation Testing:
   - Test with real-world SEC filings, especially edge cases
   - Verify handling of company-specific extensions
   - Test HTML content extraction accuracy
   - Validate context reference integrity checking

5. Monitoring System Validation:
   - Verify taxonomy-specific reporting accuracy
   - Test size-based metrics and categorization
   - Validate error pattern recognition
   - Test performance metrics collection and reporting
